security_focus_notes: All patient-owned records MUST include workspace_id for strong row-level security (RLS) and consistent access control.
Separate audit streams: AuditEvent for mutations (create/update/delete/export/restore) and SensitiveAccessEvent for reads/views/downloads of sensitive objects.
Attachments should be stored via signed URLs; store only non-secret references (e.g., object key), plus hash/size for integrity checks.
Coins and points use append-only ledgers; cached balances/levels are derived to prevent tampering and reconcile disputes.
Role-based access control (RBAC) is explicit: permissions are enumerated and mapped to roles; avoid implicit access rules in code.
notes: Canonical keys (task, points, coins, grace_token) are stable and never renamed.
Renameable UI text is stored in *Label* objects (RoleLabel, TaskTypeLabel, GoalTypeLabel, CurrencyLabel, PointsSystem).
Feature modules are admin-toggleable via FeatureModuleSetting (with dependency checks).
Notifications unify prior 'alerts' and general notifications into a single system.
Single-client now; Workspace enables later multi-client expansion without schema migration pain.

Workspace.description: Security boundary and future multi-client container. Single-client v1 still uses a workspace.

WorkspaceMembership.description: Users belong to a workspace with a role. This enables later multi-client expansion cleanly.

RolePermission.description: Maps roles to allowed permissions; workspace-scoped overrides are supported.

RoleLabel.description: Renameable display labels for roles (e.g., Joey/Emily/Family).

User.description: A person account in the app.

PatientProfile.description: Profile for the supported person (single-client now; can expand later).

FeatureModule.description: Canonical list of major modules, with dependencies for safe toggling.

FeatureModuleSetting.description: Admin-controlled enable/disable for each module for a given workspace+patient.

PointsSystem.description: Renameable labels for points (e.g., 'Points' vs 'Victory Points').

CurrencyLabel.description: Renameable labels for currencies (coins, grace tokens).

LevelSystem.description: Points accumulate into levels. Curve can be explicit table or formula.

LevelCurve.description: Defines required cumulative points per level.

LevelCurveStep.description: Explicit table: required cumulative points to reach each level.

UserProgress.description: Cached progress for fast UI: derived from PointsLedgerEntry + LevelCurve.

PointsLedgerEntry.description: Append-only ledger of points earned/spent/adjusted. TaskInstances and bonuses should write to this.

Event.description: Appointments and social events. Tasks can link to events via Task.source_link_type='event'.

TaskTag.description: Simple tags for tasks; can be used in streak filters and grouping.

Task.description: Base task definition. TaskInstances represent daily scoring.

TaskTagLink.description: Many-to-many linking between tasks and tags.

TaskInstance.description: A dated instance of a task. Writes points to PointsLedgerEntry when completed.

points_awarded.notes: Snapshot for historical scoring; ledger is authoritative.

RecurrenceRule.description: Defines how a recurring task generates TaskInstances.

BonusAvailabilitySetting.description: Defines availability caps for bonus tasks.

TaskGroup.description: A named group of tasks that awards bonus points if N tasks are completed on a day.

TaskGroupTaskLink.description: Membership link between TaskGroup and Task.

TaskGroupDailyResult.description: Daily evaluation for group bonus points. Writes to PointsLedgerEntry when awarded.

Goal.description: Generic goal/project with approval workflow and optional decay.

GoalTaskLink.description: Connects a goal to its component tasks.

Medication.description: Drug/product concept. One Medication can be used by many Prescriptions.

Prescription.description: Patient-specific medication order/recommendation. Tracks instructions, schedule, refills, prescriber, pharmacy.

MedicationSchedule.description: Structured schedule for reminders and consumption planning; supports multiple blocks per prescription.

Dispense.description: Each pharmacy fill event for a prescription.

InsuranceClaim.description: Minimal placeholder to link dispense costs/coverage.

Notification.description: Unified delivery object for reminders/alerts/info. Replaces prior Alert table.

RenewalPlanStep.description: Ordered checklist steps for a renewal plan.

RenewalAttempt.description: Log of attempts to contact pharmacy/provider for refills/renewals.

ProviderDiscussionItem.description: Items to bring up with a provider.

BudgetAccount.description: Accounts/income sources with spending restrictions (e.g., SNAP).

ShoppingList.description: Shopping list generated from recipes + favorites.

ShoppingListItem.description: Items on a shopping list with two-stage checkoff.

TransitionBuffer.description: Transition buffers for planning. Can be applied to events via rules or manual selection.

CopingActivity.description: Self-soothing / boredom activities with quick instructions.

Attachment.description: Files/photos associated with records. Designed for secure storage and access control.

object_key.notes: Non-secret storage reference (e.g., bucket key). Do NOT store long-lived public URLs.

ShareLink.description: Optional secure share links for attachments (short-lived, revocable).

AuditEvent.description: Mutation audit log (create/update/delete/export/restore). No view logging here to reduce noise.

field_changes.notes: For update: {field: {old, new}}. Consider redaction for sensitive fields.

SensitiveAccessEvent.description: Read/view/download audit for sensitive objects (health/budget/attachments). This is the security emphasis layer.

CoinWallet.description: Cached coin balance; authoritative source is CoinLedgerEntry.

StoreItem.description: Admin-curated store catalog; items can be enabled/disabled per patient.

metadata.notes: Type-specific: sticker asset, reward instructions, token identity (e.g., grace_token).

Purchase.description: A purchase record for a store item (coins spent).

Redemption.description: Fulfillment workflow for real-world rewards (and optional approval gates).

UserInventory.description: What the user owns (tokens, stickers, entitlements).

Sticker.description: Sticker asset definition (typically referenced by StoreItem metadata).

HomeDecoration.description: Placed decorative items on the home page (stickers or other decorations).

StreakDefinition.description: Admin-configured streaks from templates + filters, awarding coins; supports token shielding.

filter.notes: Pick-from-list constraints: {task_group_ids[], task_type_keys[], task_tag_ids[], source_link_types[], task_allowlist_ids[]}

grace_token_store_item_id.notes: Consumable token item used to shield a break.

StreakState.description: User’s current progress for a streak.

StreakShieldUse.description: Explicit record of consuming a token to prevent a streak break (for explainability + security).

AuthSession.description: Security object: active user sessions for revocation and incident response.

ApiToken.description: Security object: future integrations. Store only hashed token; never store plaintext.

recommended_invariants: RLS: Every query must be constrained by workspace_id; patient-owned tables must also constrain by patient_id when applicable.
RBAC: All sensitive operations must check RolePermission at runtime; do not hardcode role behavior.
AuditEvent must be written for create/update/delete/export/restore for any object.
SensitiveAccessEvent must be written for view/download/print/share operations on high-sensitivity objects (medications/prescriptions/intake/budget/attachments).
Do not store long-lived public URLs for attachments. Use object_key + signed URLs generated on demand; log SensitiveAccessEvent on access.
Coins: CoinLedgerEntry is authoritative; CoinWallet is a cache only.
Points: PointsLedgerEntry is authoritative; UserProgress.total_points and levels are caches only.
Task completion: When a TaskInstance transitions to done, write a PointsLedgerEntry and (optionally) a CoinLedgerEntry if the design later allows task coin rewards.
Group bonuses: Awarding a TaskGroupDailyResult must write a PointsLedgerEntry linked to that result.
Notifications unify previous alerts: do not reintroduce a separate Alert table in v1.0.
Feature toggles: Enabling/disabling must enforce FeatureModule dependencies to prevent broken states.
Streak shielding: If a streak is saved via token, decrement UserInventory.quantity, create StreakShieldUse, and update StreakState.last_shielded_at.
Tokens/grace: The 'grace_token' label is renameable via CurrencyLabel, but token identity is enforced by StoreItem.type=consumable_token and metadata token_key='grace_token'.
Sessions/tokens: Store only hashes for ApiToken/token secrets; revoke tokens and sessions on suspicion and log in AuditEvent.

deprecations.notes: All prior alert types (dose_reminder, refill_due, etc.) are now Notification.type values.
